name: booqable-operator-console
description: Modular rebuild of the Booqable rental dashboard — web and Mobile POS

scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run build:android
scripts.build:android: node build.mjs --entry mobile/main.js --styles mobile/styles --out android.html --title "Northlight for Android" --fonts "family=Roboto:wght@400;500;700&family=Roboto+Mono:wght@400;500"
scripts.test: npm run test:api && npm run test:e2e
